column3: NASB renders “evangelized” as “preached” and “have stood” as “stand.”
NASB renders “in the foremost” as “as of first importance.”
NASB follows the critical text (“the third day”); “has been raised” is rendered “was raised.”
NASB follows the critical text without “also”; “above” is rendered “more than,” and “were fallen asleep” is “have fallen asleep.”
NASB renders “an untimely birth” as “one untimely born” and adds “as it were.”
NASB renders “void” as “vain” and “toiled” as “labored”; it adds “prove.”
NASB follows the critical text (“also”); “void” is rendered “vain.”
NASB moves “only” and renders “more to be pitied than all men” as “of all men most to be pitied.”
NASB follows the critical text without “became.”
NASB follows the critical text. A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text (“delivers up”); it adds “comes” and renders “annulled” as “abolished” and “dominion” as “rule.”
NASB puts the first quotation in capitals and renders “it may be said” as “He says.”
